chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
Regarding His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He:
"The dyeing of Allah, and who is better than Allah in dyeing?"
He عليه السلام said: "He dyed the believers with the wilayah in the Covenant."

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One who bestows the true spiritual mark
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers who receive this divine distinction
key_terms.الْمِيثَاقِ: the covenant, the primordial pact in which this designation occurred
key_terms.بِالْوَلَايَةِ: through wilayah, divinely ordained authority and allegiance
key_terms.صِبْغَةَ: a dyeing, coloring, or distinguishing mark

ai.seo_question: What does "the dyeing of Allah" mean in Qur'an 2:138 according to Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration interprets the Qur'anic phrase "the dyeing of Allah" as the believers being marked and distinguished through wilayah at the time of the primordial covenant. It presents wilayah as a divinely bestowed spiritual identity and covenantal designation for the believers.
